Enclose two recent pass port size self-attested photographs.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates in support of age and qualification.
Attach self-attested copy of discharge certificate.
Enclose two-character certificates attested by two different Group-B Gazetted Officers.
Submit the application form by hand or post to reach the O/o the D.I.G. of Police, ER, Baleshwar on or before 17.10.2026 at 5.30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises verification of original documents, Medical Test, Physical Test, and Interview. Candidates shall be put through a medical test. A Medical Board shall test the physical fitness of the candidates and the decision of the Board is final and binding. Persons with physical deformities shall not be eligible for appointment. Candidates must be physically fit and mentally alert, capable of discharging field duty by putting in hard labor for at least 8 hours a day during day or night. Candidates have to cover a distance of 5 (five) kilometers on foot within a period of one hour. Those who fail to cover the above distance within the time will be disqualified. Candidates who qualify in the medical test and physical test will appear before the Selection Board for interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is Odisha Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Odisha Police Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment drive for retired Asst. Sub-Inspectors, Sub-Inspectors, and Inspectors of Police for contractual engagement as Special Police Officers (SPOs) across Eastern Range districts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Odisha Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 84 vacancies available for Special Police Officers across Baleshwar, Mayurbhanj, Bhadrak, and Rairangpur Police District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 17 October 2026 by 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Retired Asst. Sub-Inspectors, Sub-Inspectors, and Inspectors of Police who are permanent residents of Odisha, aged not more than 65 years, with an unblemished service record and meeting all specified conditions can apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be more than 65 years of age as on the date of publication of the advertisement.
